description: This Java source file defines the class FineractExternalEventConfigCondition, which extends PropertiesCondition and provides logic to determine if certain configurations related to external event partitions are valid, based on the partition size value in the properties.

classes.name: FineractExternalEventConfigCondition
classes.description: A class that extends PropertiesCondition and overrides the matches method to validate external event partition sizes.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the external event partition size in the given properties exceeds 25000 or is less than 1, logs errors in these cases, and returns whether the condition fails.
